title: AWS Lambda Secrets Manager Extension
description: Lambda function that uses the Secrets Manager Lambda Extension.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This sample project demonstrates how to use a Lambda function to retrieve secrets using the Secrets Manager Lambda extension in the us-east-1 region. Other regions may be used by swapping the Secrets Manager layer in the template.yaml file.

testing.headline: Testing
text: See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.
